tasks.description: The dashboard will be used to display reports. The details of the reports are still to be determined. This task involves setting up the basic structure of the dashboard.
acceptance_criteria: Given a user is logged in, when they navigate to the dashboard, then they see a placeholder for reports.

tasks.description: This task involves determining the specifics of the reports that will be displayed on the dashboard. This includes the type of data, the format of the reports, and any filtering or sorting options.
acceptance_criteria: Given a product owner, when they review the report details, then they can confirm that the details meet the requirements.

tasks.description: This task involves implementing the display of reports on the dashboard. This includes integrating with any data sources, handling filtering and sorting, and displaying the reports in the desired format.
acceptance_criteria: Given a user is logged in, when they navigate to the dashboard, then they see the reports displayed with the correct data and formatting.
